subject: general
question: Which of the following cities is situated on river bank of Sabarmati?
solution:
The correct answer is option** 4** i.e.** __Ahmedabad__**.

 
• **The Sabarmati river** is the **major west-flowing rivers **in India.
 
• It originates in the** Aravalli Range of Rajasthan** and **falls the Gulf of Khambhat **of the** Arabian Sea.**
 
• Sabarmati is known as one of the most polluted rivers in India.
